{{Top|leg}}
The '''galactic cup''' was a reward to the winner of the [[Chandrila Equinoid Derby]], a sporting event during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] held on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] that involved riding animals.<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The galactic cup was first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook for the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] series.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
